name: pinned-superseded-record-serves-its-reign-immutably
description: Epoch history (#483, SPEC §7.1.2.2): a session whose head advanced to epoch 1 still serves its superseded epoch-0 record on the pinned locator — with the props of ITS reign (the amended mint state), never the successor's — and serves them byte-identically on a second read. The bare locator meanwhile tracks the live head. Immutability is graded on propsJson only: live-channel tokens on the same meta legitimately differ per read; the RECORD is what may not.
